subject: 飛行儀表 - 皮托靜壓系統與高度計原理

mc_questions.zh_question: 當飛機開啟備用靜壓源 (Alternate Static Source) 時，儀表指示會發生什麼變化？
zh_options: (A) 高度計指示的高度會比實際高度略低
(B) 空速表 (ASI) 指示的空速會比實際空速略大
(C) 垂直速率表 (VSI) 會顯示持續性的下降
(D) 所有儀表指示皆不會改變
mc_questions.en_question: What changes occur in instrument indications when the alternate static source is utilized?
en_options: (A) The altimeter indicates a slightly lower altitude than actual.
(B) The ASI indicates an airspeed greater than the actual airspeed.
(C) The VSI shows a constant descent.
(D) There are no changes in instrument indications.
mc_questions.explanation: 由於文氏管效應 (Venturi effect)，駕駛艙內的氣壓通常低於外部氣壓。開啟 Alternate Static Source 時，儀表感測到的靜壓較低，導致 Altimeter 讀數偏高、ASI 讀數偏大（因為動壓與靜壓的差值變大），而 VSI 則會先顯示瞬間爬升後再歸零。

mc_questions.zh_question: 關於高度計內部的真空膜盒 (Aneroid Wafers)，下列敘述何者正確？
zh_options: (A) 膜盒內部密封壓力為 29.92 吋汞柱
(B) 當大氣壓力增加時，膜盒會膨脹
(C) 膜盒膨脹會帶動機械連桿顯示高度降低
(D) 膜盒與皮托孔 (Pitot Tube) 直接相連
mc_questions.en_question: Which of the following statements regarding the altimeter's aneroid wafers is correct?
en_options: (A) The wafers are sealed to an internal pressure of 29.92 inches of mercury.
(B) The wafers expand when atmospheric pressure increases.
(C) Wafer expansion drives the linkage to indicate a decrease in altitude.
(D) The wafers are directly connected to the pitot tube.
mc_questions.explanation: 高度計核心由一疊密封的 Aneroid Wafers 組成，內部壓力固定為 29.92 Hg。當外界靜壓降低（高度增加）時，膜盒會膨脹 (Expand)，進而驅動指針指示更高的高度。

mc_questions.zh_question: 在未調整高度計撥定值的情況下，從高壓區飛往低壓區會導致什麼危害？
zh_options: (A) 指示高度低於實際高度，增加碰撞風險
(B) 實際高度高於指示高度，導致飛機超限
(C) 實際高度低於指示高度，可能導致飛機撞地
(D) 儀表會自動修正，無任何影響
mc_questions.en_question: What hazard exists when flying from a high-pressure area to a low-pressure area without adjusting the altimeter setting?
en_options: (A) Indicated altitude is lower than actual altitude, increasing collision risk.
(B) Actual altitude is higher than indicated altitude, leading to exceedance.
(C) Actual altitude is lower than indicated altitude, potentially leading to controlled flight into terrain.
(D) The instrument self-corrects with no impact.
mc_questions.explanation: 航空界有一句名言「From High to Low, Look Out Below」。當飛機從高壓飛往低壓而未修正撥定值時，高度計會維持在較高的讀數，但飛機的實際高度 (Actual/True Altitude) 其實已經下降，這對障礙物避讓 (Terrain Clearance) 極具危險。

mc_questions.zh_question: 當飛機從高壓力區飛往低壓力區，且飛行員未根據當地的 Altimeter Setting 重新調整高度計時，下列敘述何者正確？
zh_options: (A) 高度計指針會顯示比實際高度更高的高度
(B) 飛機的實際高度（True Altitude）會低於高度計指示的高度
(C) 飛機的實際高度（True Altitude）會高於高度計指示的高度
(D) 此情況對飛行安全沒有任何影響
mc_questions.en_question: When flying from a high-pressure area to a low-pressure area without resetting the altimeter to the local altimeter setting, which statement is true?
en_options: (A) The altimeter needles will indicate a higher altitude than the actual position
(B) The aircraft's True Altitude will be lower than the Indicated Altitude
(C) The aircraft's True Altitude will be higher than the Indicated Altitude
(D) This situation has no impact on flight safety
mc_questions.explanation: 這是航空界著名的「High to Low, Look Out Below」觀念。當外界大氣壓力下降而高度計仍設定在較高的壓力值時，高度計會誤以為飛機處於較低位置而指示較高的高度。因此，飛行員若維持相同的 Indicated Altitude，實際上飛機的高度會持續下降，可能導致 True Altitude 低於 Indicated Altitude，造成撞地風險。

mc_questions.zh_question: 關於升降速表（VSI）的運作邏輯，為何在剛開始爬升或下降時會出現指示滯後（Lag）？
zh_options: (A) 因為膜盒（Diaphragm）的材質膨脹係數太低
(B) 因為 Static Line 的管路太長導致空氣傳輸延遲
(C) 因為內部有一關鍵組件 Calibrated Leak 限制了殼體（Case）內壓力的變化速率
(D) 這是為了防止指針過於敏感而設計的機械阻尼器
mc_questions.en_question: Regarding the operational logic of the Vertical Speed Indicator (VSI), why does an indication lag occur during the initial climb or descent?
en_options: (A) Due to the low expansion coefficient of the diaphragm material
(B) Due to the length of the static line causing air transmission delay
(C) Because a key component called 'Calibrated Leak' restricts the rate of pressure change inside the case
(D) It is a mechanical damper designed to prevent the needle from being overly sensitive
mc_questions.explanation: VSI 是一個差壓儀表。膜盒（Diaphragm）接收不受限的 Static Pressure，而儀表殼體（Case）則透過一個校準洩漏孔（Calibrated Leak）接收靜壓。當高度改變時，膜盒壓力立即變化，但殼體壓力因洩漏孔限制需一段時間（約 6-9 秒）才能達成平衡。這段壓力差的時間就是 Lag，直到變率穩定後，指針才會顯示正確的 Rate Information。

mc_questions.zh_question: 當氣溫高於標準大氣溫度時，關於密度高度（Density Altitude）與飛機性能的關係，下列何者敘述正確？
zh_options: (A) 密度高度會降低，增加發動機馬力與螺旋槳效率
(B) 密度高度會升高，導致發動機進氣量增加進而提升性能
(C) 密度高度會降低，導致起飛滾行距離縮短
(D) 密度高度會升高，導致空氣分子較少，降低發動機功率與螺旋槳效率
mc_questions.en_question: When the air temperature is higher than standard, what is the relationship between Density Altitude and aircraft performance?
en_options: (A) Density altitude decreases, increasing engine horsepower and propeller efficiency
(B) Density altitude increases, leading to more air intake and improved performance
(C) Density altitude decreases, resulting in a shorter takeoff roll
(D) Density altitude increases, resulting in fewer air molecules, reducing engine power and propeller efficiency
mc_questions.explanation: 高溫會使空氣密度下降，導致密度高度（Density Altitude）升高。在這種「稀薄」的空氣中，自然進氣（Naturally Aspirated）發動機的進氣量減少，馬力下降；同時螺旋槳與機翼產生的推力與升力也因空氣分子減少而效率降低，進而導致起飛距離變長及爬升率下降。

mc_questions.zh_question: 當皮托管(Pitot Tube)入口與排水孔(Drain Hole)同時被冰堵塞,且飛機正在爬升時,空速表(ASI)會如何反應?
zh_options: (A) 空速指示降至零
(B) 空速指示維持在堵塞發生時的數值不變
(C) 空速指示會隨高度增加而上升(類似高度計)
(D) 空速指示會劇烈波動
mc_questions.en_question: If both the pitot tube opening and the drain hole become blocked while the aircraft is climbing, how will the Airspeed Indicator (ASI) react?
en_options: (A) The airspeed indication drops to zero
(B) The airspeed indication remains constant at the speed where blockage occurred
(C) The airspeed indication increases with altitude (acts like an altimeter)
(D) The airspeed indication will fluctuate violently
mc_questions.explanation: 當入口與排水孔皆堵塞時,皮托管內的壓力被密封(Trapped)。隨高度增加,外部靜壓降低,導致膜盒內外壓差變大,空速表會像高度計一樣隨高度增加而顯示數值上升。

mc_questions.zh_question: 在靜壓孔(Static Port)發生堵塞的情況下進行爬升,空速表(ASI)的指示會出現什麼偏差?
zh_options: (A) 指示速會大於實際空速
(B) 指示速會小於實際空速
(C) 指示速保持準確
(D) 指示速會跳動
mc_questions.en_question: During a climb with a blocked static port, what error will the Airspeed Indicator (ASI) display?
en_options: (A) It will indicate a speed higher than actual airspeed
(B) It will indicate a speed lower than actual airspeed
(C) It will remain accurate
(D) The indication will oscillate
mc_questions.explanation: 靜壓孔堵塞會將較高壓力的空氣鎖在儀表殼內。爬升時,實際外部壓力降低,但儀表仍對照堵塞處的高壓,導致指示空速低於實際值(Under-read)。

mc_questions.zh_question: 在電子飛行儀表系統(EFD)中,大氣數據電腦(ADC)主要接收哪些感測器訊號來計算空速與高度?
zh_options: (A) 僅皮托管與靜壓孔
(B) 皮托管、靜壓孔以及機外溫度(OAT)探頭
(C) 陀螺儀與加速度計
(D) 磁力計與 GPS
mc_questions.en_question: In an Electronic Flight Display (EFD) system, which sensors provide the primary inputs for the Air Data Computer (ADC) to calculate airspeed and altitude?
en_options: (A) Pitot tube and static port only
(B) Pitot tube, static port, and Outside Air Temperature (OAT) probe
(C) Gyros and accelerometers
(D) Magnetometer and GPS
mc_questions.explanation: ADC 接收 Pitot-Static 系統的壓力訊號以及 OAT 探頭的溫度訊號,藉此計算指示空速、真空速(TAS)以及氣壓高度。

mc_questions.zh_question: 根據陀螺儀的進動性 (Precession) 原理，當一個偏轉力 (Deflective force) 作用於旋轉中的陀螺儀時，其實際反應會發生在何處？
zh_options: (A) 作用力施加的同一點
(B) 作用力施加點沿旋轉方向領先 90 度處
(C) 作用力施加點沿旋轉方向領先 180 度處
(D) 陀螺儀旋轉軸心點
mc_questions.en_question: Based on the principle of gyroscopic precession, when a deflective force is applied to a spinning gyro, where does the actual reaction occur?
en_options: (A) At the same point where the force was applied
(B) At a point 90 degrees later in the direction of rotation
(C) At a point 180 degrees later in the direction of rotation
(D) At the center of the gyro's rotation axis
mc_questions.explanation: 進動性 (Precession) 是陀螺儀對外力反應的特性。根據物理特性，其反應不會發生在受力點，而是會延遲出現在旋轉方向後方的 90 度位置。此原理被應用於 Turn Coordinator 等儀表來感測轉向率。

mc_questions.zh_question: 陀螺儀的「空間穩定性」(Rigidity in Space) 主要取決於哪兩項設計特性？
zh_options: (A) 轉子尺寸與軸承潤滑度
(B) 進動速度與安裝架的平面數
(C) 高密度 (重量大) 與高速旋轉
(D) 真空壓力的穩定度與環境溫度
mc_questions.en_question: The 'Rigidity in Space' of a gyroscope primarily depends on which two design characteristics?
en_options: (A) Rotor size and bearing lubrication
(B) Precession speed and the number of gimbal planes
(C) High density (weight for size) and high rotation speed
(D) Stability of vacuum pressure and ambient temperature
mc_questions.explanation: 空間穩定性 (Rigidity in Space) 是陀螺儀在旋轉時保持其在空間中固定位置的能力。這主要由轉子的質量 (High density) 以及旋轉的速度所決定，轉速越高、質量越集中在邊緣，穩定性越強。

mc_questions.zh_question: 為什麼現代飛機的儀表系統 (如 Heading Indicator 與 Turn Coordinator) 通常會採用不同的動力來源 (例如真空與電力混合)？
zh_options: (A) 為了減輕飛機整體的重量
(B) 電子儀表比真空儀表更精準
(C) 真空系統無法驅動 Turn Coordinator
(D) 為了在單一系統故障時仍能提供基本的銀行 (Bank) 資訊
mc_questions.en_question: Why do modern aircraft instrument systems typically use different power sources (e.g., a mix of vacuum and electric) for gyros?
en_options: (A) To reduce the overall weight of the aircraft
(B) Electronic instruments are more accurate than vacuum ones
(C) The vacuum system cannot drive the Turn Coordinator
(D) To ensure bank information is available if one power source fails
mc_questions.explanation: 這是一種備援 (Redundancy) 設計邏輯。若 Heading Indicator 與 Attitude Indicator 使用真空系統，而 Turn Coordinator 使用電力，當真空泵失效時，飛行員仍能透過電力驅動的儀表獲得基本的姿態與航向參考。

mc_questions.zh_question: 在隸屬控制與補償單元 (Slaving Control and Compensator Unit) 中，補償儀表 (Slaving Meter) 指針向右偏轉代表什麼含義？
zh_options: (A) 航向卡存在逆時針誤差
(B) 航向卡存在順時針誤差
(C) 飛機正在向右轉彎
(D) 通訊無線電產生干擾
mc_questions.en_question: What does a right deflection on the slaving meter of a Slaving Control and Compensator Unit indicate?
en_options: (A) A counter-clockwise error of the compass card
(B) A clockwise error of the compass card
(C) The aircraft is in a right turn
(D) Interference from communication radios
mc_questions.explanation: 根據系統邏輯，補償儀表顯示的是顯示航向與磁航向之間的差異。右偏 (Right deflection) 代表航向卡存在順時針誤差 (Clockwise error)，左偏則代表逆時針誤差。

mc_questions.zh_question: 關於攻角指示器 (AOA Indicator) 的特性，下列哪項參數『不會』影響臨界攻角 (Critical AOA)？
zh_options: (A) 飛機重量 (Weight)
(B) 坡度 (Bank Angle)
(C) 溫度 (Temperature)
(D) 以上皆是
mc_questions.en_question: Regarding the characteristics of an Angle of Attack (AOA) indicator, which of the following parameters does NOT affect the critical AOA?
en_options: (A) Aircraft weight
(B) Bank angle
(C) Temperature
(D) All of the above
mc_questions.explanation: 臨界攻角 (Critical AOA) 是一個固定值，飛機總是在相同的攻角下失速。它不受重量、坡度、溫度、空氣密度或重心位置的影響。雖然失速速度 (Stall Speed) 會隨這些因素改變，但失速攻角保持不變。

mc_questions.zh_question: 若使用非自動找北功能的自由陀螺儀 (Free Gyro) 航向儀，建議大約每隔多久應與磁力指南針進行校對重設？
zh_options: (A) 每 5 分鐘
(B) 每 15 分鐘
(C) 每 30 分鐘
(D) 僅在起飛前校對一次即可
mc_questions.en_question: For a free gyro heading indicator without automatic north-seeking capability, how often should it be checked and reset to align with the magnetic compass?
en_options: (A) Every 5 minutes
(B) Every 15 minutes
(C) Every 30 minutes
(D) Only once before takeoff
mc_questions.explanation: 由於摩擦導致的進動 (Precession)，自由陀螺儀的航向會隨時間產生誤差。因此建議大約每 15 分鐘在飛機平飛且穩定速度時，重新將其與磁力指南針校準。

mc_questions.zh_question: 在北緯 40 度地區進行轉向至北方的操作時,為了補償北轉誤差(Northerly Turning Error),飛行員應在羅盤指示到達預定航向多少度之前停止轉彎?
mc_questions.en_question: When turning to a northerly heading at 40 degrees North latitude, how many degrees prior to the desired heading should the pilot stop the turn to compensate for northerly turning error?
en_options: (A) 15 degrees
(B) 20 degrees
(C) 35 degrees
(D) 55 degrees
mc_questions.explanation: 根據影片中的修正法則,北轉誤差的修正量為 15 度加上緯度的一半 (15 + 1/2 Latitude)。在北緯 40 度,修正量為 15 + 20 = 35 度。因此應在預定航向前 35 度停止轉彎。

mc_questions.zh_question: 當飛機在東(East)或西(West)航向上加速時,磁羅盤會因為磁傾角(Magnetic Dip)與慣性作用產生什麼誤差?
zh_options: (A) 指示向南轉向 (Indication toward South)
(B) 指示向北轉向 (Indication toward North)
(C) 羅盤卡會發生震盪但航向不變
(D) 產生與緯度成正比的延遲誤差
mc_questions.en_question: When an aircraft accelerates on an easterly or westerly heading, what error occurs in the magnetic compass due to magnetic dip and inertia?
en_options: (A) An indication toward South
(B) An indication toward North
(C) Oscillations of the card without heading change
(D) A lag error proportional to latitude
mc_questions.explanation: 這可以用口訣 ANDS (Accelerate North, Decelerate South) 來記憶。加速時,羅盤會顯示向北轉向的誤差(Indication toward North),減速時則顯示向南轉向。

mc_questions.zh_question: 關於垂直卡式磁羅盤 (Vertical Card Magnetic Compass) 的敘述,下列何者正確?
zh_options: (A) 它使用液體阻尼來消除所有加速誤差
(B) 它完全消除了北向轉彎誤差
(C) 它利用渦流阻尼 (Eddy current damping) 來減少震盪
(D) 它的刻度盤是固定的,由指針移動指示航向
mc_questions.en_question: Which statement regarding the Vertical Card Magnetic Compass is correct?
en_options: (A) It uses liquid damping to eliminate all acceleration errors
(B) It completely eliminates northerly turning errors
(C) It utilizes eddy current damping to decrease oscillations
(D) It has a fixed dial with a needle indicating the heading
mc_questions.explanation: 垂直卡式磁羅盤通過渦流阻尼 (Eddy current damping) 機制,利用永久磁鐵產生的通量與阻尼杯產生的渦流相互作用,來有效減少儀表的震盪(Oscillations)。

cloze_items.cloze_text: The pitot-static system is utilized for the operation of the airspeed indicator, altimeter, and {{c1::vertical speed indicator}}.
cloze_items.zh_translation: 皮托靜壓系統用於操作空速表、高度計以及垂直速率表。
cloze_items.explanation: 這三種儀表是依靠靜壓與全壓（動壓）的變化來運作的。

cloze_items.cloze_text: The altimeter is an aneroid barometer that measures the pressure of the atmosphere at the level where the {{c1::altimeter}} is located.
cloze_items.zh_translation: 高度計是一種真空壓力計，用來測量高度計所在位置的大氣壓力。
cloze_items.explanation: 高度計本質上是測量環境靜壓，並將其轉換為英呎讀數。

cloze_items.cloze_text: An altimeter error occurs when flying from a hot area to a {{c1::cold}} area, causing the true altitude to be lower than indicated.
cloze_items.zh_translation: 當從高溫區飛往低溫區時會產生高度計誤差，導致實際高度低於指示高度。
cloze_items.explanation: 冷空氣密度較大，等壓面高度較低，因此高度計會誤導飛行員以為高度足夠。

cloze_items.cloze_text: On a typical altimeter dial, the short, wide needle indicates {{c1::thousands}} of feet.
cloze_items.zh_translation: 在典型的高度計刻度盤上，短且寬的指針指示幾千英呎。
cloze_items.explanation: 長針指示百英呎，短寬針指示千英呎，帶三角形頂端的細長針指示萬英呎。

cloze_items.cloze_text: Due to the Venturi effect of air flowing around the fuselage, the air pressure inside the flight deck is {{c1::lower}} than the exterior pressure.
cloze_items.zh_translation: 由於氣流繞過機身的文氏管效應，駕駛艙內的氣壓比外部壓力低。
cloze_items.explanation: 這是導致備用靜壓源產生誤差的主要物理原因。

cloze_items.cloze_text: If the altimeter cannot be adjusted for a non-standard pressure setting above {{c1::31.00}} Hg, actual altitude is higher than indicated.
cloze_items.zh_translation: 如果高度計無法針對超過 31.00 Hg 的非標準氣壓撥定值進行調整，則實際高度會高於指示高度。
cloze_items.explanation: 這是高度計調整機構的物理限制數據之一。

cloze_items.cloze_text: During an instrument check, the altimeter pointer should indicate the surveyed field elevation; if the indication is off more than {{c1::75}} feet, the instrument should be referred for recalibration.
cloze_items.zh_translation: 進行儀表檢查時，高度計應顯示該機場測量的高度；如果誤差超過 75 呎，則應將該儀表送去重新校正。
cloze_items.explanation: 這是高度計在飛行前檢查時的重要限制數值，超過此範圍則視為不可靠（Unreliable）。

cloze_items.cloze_text: A rule of thumb for finding TAS is to add {{c1::2}} percent to the CAS for each 1,000 feet of altitude.
cloze_items.zh_translation: 計算真空速（TAS）的一個經驗法則是在校準空速（CAS）的基礎上，每 1,000 呎高度增加 2%。
cloze_items.explanation: 這是在飛行計畫階段常用於估算高高度航行性能的簡易口訣。

cloze_items.cloze_text: The {{c1::White Arc}} on the airspeed indicator is commonly referred to as the flap operating range.
cloze_items.zh_translation: 空速表上的白弧通常被稱為襟翼操作範圍。
cloze_items.explanation: 白弧的下限是 VS0（著陸構型失速速度），上限是 VFE（襟翼最大伸展速度）。

cloze_items.cloze_text: Pressure altitude is the altitude indicated when the altimeter setting window is adjusted to {{c1::29.92}} Hg.
cloze_items.zh_translation: 壓力高度是指當高度計設定窗口調整為 29.92 英吋汞柱時所顯示的高度。
cloze_items.explanation: 這是定義壓力高度的標準基準值（Standard Datum Plane），用於各種性能數據計算。

cloze_items.cloze_text: The typical VSI has a lag period from the initial change in the rate of climb until it displays an accurate indication of about {{c1::6 to 9}} seconds.
cloze_items.zh_translation: 典型的升降速表（VSI）從開始改變爬升率到顯示準確指示，大約有 6 到 9 秒的滯後時間。
cloze_items.explanation: 這種滯後是由殼體校準洩漏孔（Calibrated Leak）的壓力平衡過程所造成的。

cloze_items.cloze_text: True altitude is the vertical distance of the aircraft above {{c1::mean sea level}} (MSL).
cloze_items.zh_translation: 實際高度是指飛機高於平均海平面（MSL）的垂直距離。
cloze_items.explanation: 航圖上的地形高度與障礙物高度都是以 True Altitude (MSL) 表示，對避障至關重要。

cloze_items.cloze_text: The airspeed indicator will read {{c1::zero}} if the pitot tube is blocked but the drain hole remains open.
cloze_items.zh_translation: 如果皮托管入口堵塞但排水孔保持暢通,空速表將顯示零。
cloze_items.explanation: 因為動壓空氣無法進入且殘餘壓力由排水孔洩出,導致與靜壓相等,壓差為零。

cloze_items.cloze_text: If the static port is blocked, the {{c1::altimeter}} will freeze at the altitude where the blockage occurred.
cloze_items.zh_translation: 如果靜壓孔堵塞,高度計將凍結在堵塞發生時的高度。
cloze_items.explanation: 高度計運作完全依賴靜壓變化,一旦靜壓源被切斷且壓力被鎖定,指針將不再移動。

cloze_items.cloze_text: Design maneuvering speed (V_A) is the speed at which the aircraft will {{c1::stall}} before it causes structural damage.
cloze_items.zh_translation: 設計操縱速度 (V_A) 是指飛機在造成結構損壞之前會先發生失速的速度。
cloze_items.explanation: 在 V_A 以下進行全舵量操縱是安全的,因為飛機負荷過大前會先失速以釋放壓力。

cloze_items.cloze_text: On an EFD airspeed tape, the trend vector shows where the airspeed will be in {{c1::6}} seconds.
cloze_items.zh_translation: 在電子儀表的空速帶上,趨勢向量顯示 6 秒後的空速預測位置。
cloze_items.explanation: 這是 ADC 根據目前的加速率計算出的短期趨勢預測。

cloze_items.cloze_text: The blue line on the airspeed indicator of a multi-engine aircraft represents {{c1::V_YSE}}.
cloze_items.zh_translation: 多發動機飛機空速表上的藍線代表 V_YSE (單發最速爬升速度)。
cloze_items.explanation: 這是在一具發動機失效時,能獲得最佳爬升率或最小下降率的空速。

cloze_items.cloze_text: Precession is the tilting or turning of a gyro in response to a {{c1::deflective force}}.
cloze_items.zh_translation: 進動性是陀螺儀因偏轉力而產生的傾斜或轉動反應。
cloze_items.explanation: 這是陀螺儀兩大核心特性之一，也是姿態儀和航向儀運作的基礎。

cloze_items.cloze_text: The rate at which the gyro precesses is {{c1::inversely proportional}} to the speed of the rotor.
cloze_items.zh_translation: 陀螺儀進動的速率與轉子的旋轉速度成反比。
cloze_items.explanation: 轉速越高，陀螺儀越穩定，對於相同外力的進動反應就越小。

cloze_items.cloze_text: A typical vacuum system instrument operation usually ranges between {{c1::4.5 and 5.5}} inches of mercury (Hg).
cloze_items.zh_translation: 典型的真空系統儀表運作壓力通常介於 4.5 至 5.5 英吋汞柱之間。
cloze_items.explanation: 若壓力低於此範圍，陀螺儀轉速不足，會導致 Attitude 與 Heading 指示變得不穩定或不準確。

cloze_items.cloze_text: A freely or universally mounted gyroscope is said to have {{c1::three}} planes of freedom.
cloze_items.zh_translation: 一個自由或萬向安裝的陀螺儀被認為具有三個自由平面。
cloze_items.explanation: 這允許陀螺儀在飛機改變姿態時，其旋轉軸仍能保持在空間中的固定方向。

cloze_items.cloze_text: The principle of {{c1::Rigidity in Space}} refers to the principle that a gyroscope remains in a fixed position in the plane in which it is spinning.
cloze_items.zh_translation: 空間穩定性原理是指陀螺儀保持在它旋轉平面所處的固定位置上。
cloze_items.explanation: 這是陀螺儀抵抗外力改變其旋轉平面的物理慣性特性。

cloze_items.cloze_text: When the vacuum pressure drops below the normal operating range, the gyroscopic instruments may become {{c1::unstable}} and inaccurate.
cloze_items.zh_translation: 當真空壓力降至正常工作範圍以下時，陀螺儀儀表可能會變得不穩定且不精確。
cloze_items.explanation: 這是因為轉速降低導致陀螺儀的空間穩定性下降，易受干擾而偏轉。

cloze_items.cloze_text: The Pictorial Navigation Indicator (PNI) is commonly referred to as an {{c1::HSI}}.
cloze_items.zh_translation: 圖像導航指示器 (PNI) 通常被簡稱為水平狀態指示器 (HSI)。
cloze_items.explanation: HSI (Horizontal Situation Indicator) 結合了航向儀與導航功能，是現代座艙的核心儀表。

cloze_items.cloze_text: The magnetic slaving transmitter is usually mounted in a {{c1::wingtip}} to eliminate magnetic interference.
cloze_items.zh_translation: 磁力隸屬發射器通常安裝在翼尖，以消除磁場干擾。
cloze_items.explanation: 遠離發動機和電氣設備的 Wingtip 可以最小化飛機局部磁場對 Flux Valve 的干擾。

cloze_items.cloze_text: For some heading indicators in light aircraft, the gyro will tumble if pitch or bank limits exceed {{c1::55}} degrees.
cloze_items.zh_translation: 對於某些輕型飛機的航向儀，若俯仰或坡度限制超過 55 度，陀螺儀將會翻轉 (Tumble)。
cloze_items.explanation: 這是傳統機械陀螺儀的物理限制，超過此範圍儀表將失去準確性並需要重新校準 (Caging)。

cloze_items.cloze_text: The difference between true north and magnetic north is known as {{c1::variation}}.
cloze_items.zh_translation: 真北與磁北之間的差異稱為磁偏角 (Variation)。
cloze_items.explanation: 磁偏角隨地理位置改變，飛行員需透過等磁偏線 (Isogonic lines) 進行修正。

cloze_items.cloze_text: Compass error caused by local magnetic fields within the aircraft is called {{c1::deviation}}.
cloze_items.zh_translation: 由飛機內部局部磁場引起的指南針誤差稱為磁偏差 (Deviation)。
cloze_items.explanation: 磁偏差通常由飛機上的電子設備或金屬零件引起，需透過 Swinging 程序並參考 Compass Correction Card 來修正。

cloze_items.cloze_text: The magnetic compass is filled with fluid to {{c1::damp}} the oscillations of the float and card.
cloze_items.zh_translation: 磁力指南針內充滿液體，是為了緩衝 (阻尼) 浮筒與刻度卡的震盪。
cloze_items.explanation: 液體阻尼 (Damping) 能防止羅盤在飛行中因震動或微小擾動而過度晃動，增加易讀性。

cloze_items.cloze_text: To correct for the northerly turning error, one rule of thumb is to stop the turn {{c1::15 degrees plus half the latitude}} prior to the desired heading.
cloze_items.zh_translation: 為了修正北轉誤差,一個經驗法則是比預定航向提前「15度加上緯度的一半」停止轉彎。
cloze_items.explanation: 這是飛行員在進行非陀螺儀儀表轉彎時的重要口訣,用於補償磁傾角引起的誤差。

cloze_items.zh_translation: 磁羅盤加速誤差的記憶口訣是 ANDS,代表：加速向北 / 減速向南。
cloze_items.cloze_text: A mnemonic for the effect of acceleration error is the word ANDS: {{c1::Accelerate North / Decelerate South}}.
cloze_items.explanation: ANDS 是基礎飛行訓練中最重要的口訣之一,專指在東西航向上加減速對羅盤的影響。

cloze_items.zh_translation: 當在南緯/北緯地區向南轉向時,羅盤浮盤組件會「滯後」(lag) 而非領先。
cloze_items.cloze_text: When turning in a southerly direction, the compass float assembly {{c1::lags}} rather than leads.
cloze_items.explanation: 南轉誤差與北轉誤差相反,羅盤指示會慢於實際轉彎速度,因此需要「轉過頭」一點再停止。

cloze_items.zh_translation: 室外氣溫 (OAT) 表感應元件由「雙金屬型」(bimetallic type) 溫度計組成。
cloze_items.cloze_text: The sensing element of an OAT gauge consists of a {{c1::bimetallic type}} thermometer.
cloze_items.explanation: 雙金屬溫度計利用兩種不同金屬的膨脹係數差異來測量溫度,是飛機上簡單且可靠的機械式溫度感測器。

cloze_items.zh_translation: 羅盤震盪誤差 (Oscillation Error) 是指由先前提到的所有誤差組合而成的波動。
cloze_items.cloze_text: Oscillation error is a combination of {{c1::all of the errors}} previously mentioned and results in fluctuation of the compass card.
cloze_items.explanation: 由於亂流或飛機操縱導致羅盤在液體中晃動,進而產生讀數波動,飛行員應取擺動的平均值。
